decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree is a publicly celebrated success close to the core dairy offer, so management is strongly committed to it and has no reason to drop it.
Featuring the onion and pepper cheese on the home page is a visible public commitment that management would want to justify, and it fits the firm's cheese direction.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the established organic cheese offer and uses existing farmer supply and production, so it is cheap to continue and central to the line.
A spicy cheese line with several models represents substantial invested resources, so management would persist and blame any weak results on the temporary early launch phase.
The mild creamy soft cheese extends the firm's announced growth in cheese, and with no evidence of failure, sunk development costs favor keeping it.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more of a niche product, but management's commitment to its new cheese range and the investment already made argue for persisting with it.
